title: TRICARE Select Outpatient Cost Shares - Claims Adjudication Manual
content:
**Clause.** After the deductible, a **TRICARE Select** network outpatient line carries the tier's network outpatient percentage of the remaining allowed amount where the tier's network basis is percent of allowed, and the fixed network copayment for its service class where it is fixed copayment (durable medical equipment always carries the tier's network durable medical equipment percentage); a copayment is never more than the remaining allowed amount. A non-network outpatient line - participating or nonparticipating alike - carries the tier's non-network outpatient percentage of the remaining allowed amount. Network preventive care carries the tier's network preventive care copayment and no deductible. The provider's network status is the one in the provider record on the service date. Cost shares are rounded to the cent.

The network copayment for a line is the tier's network copayment that matches the line's service class.

## Amounts on a paid line

- **Remaining allowed amount:** the allowed amount, less any other health insurance payment, less the deductible applied.
- **Cost share:** as the table below sets it, on the remaining allowed amount.
- **Beneficiary liability recorded on the line:** the deductible applied plus the cost share.

| Provider on the service date | Tier's network basis | Cost share |
|---|---|---|
| network | percent of allowed | network percentage of the remaining allowed amount, rounded to the cent |
| network | fixed copayment | the network copayment for the service class, never more than the remaining allowed amount |
| network, durable medical equipment | either | network durable medical equipment percentage of the remaining allowed amount |
| non-network (participating or nonparticipating) | either | non-network percentage of the remaining allowed amount, rounded to the cent |

## Worked lines (hypothetical)

- TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member Group A (E-5 and Above), network, allowed 200.00, deductible applied 50.00: remaining 150.00; 15 percent gives 22.50; liability 72.50.
- TRICARE Select Retiree Group B, network specialty visit, allowed 80.00, deductible already met: the copayment 56.00 is less than 80.00, so the cost share is 56.00.
- TRICARE Select Retiree Group B, non-network, allowed 80.00, deductible already met: 25 percent gives 20.00.
